_doc: Public calendar feeds registered by hand (a parish office sent its link, or a re-crawl from a home connection found it). Each entry: parish_id (entity id), type (ics | tribe_rest | calendarwiz_rss | mce_json), url (the feed), page_url (the public page where the parish publishes it), optional label (room name) and display_tz (if the parish's own embed shows another time zone). Use status 'opted_out' to honour a parish's request not to be read. run.py picks new entries up on its next run.
